title: agentscope-ai/agentscope: a framework you can watch while it runs
friendlyTitle: AgentScope is a framework you can watch while the helper runs.
summary: AgentScope gained 75 stars on GitHub's Python trending list. The repo has 36,379 stars, under Apache-2.0. The project describes 2.0 as a production-ready agent framework. Version 2.0.12 was tagged on 16 November. The repo was pushed on 20 November.
friendlySummary: AgentScope gained 75 stars on GitHub's Python trending list. The repo has 36,379 stars, under a free Apache 2.0 license. The project describes version 2.0 as a ready-to-use framework for building helpers. Version 2.0.12 was tagged on 16 November. The repo was updated on 20 November.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want to build an agent in Python and see the steps, rather than only the final reply. The 'production-ready' line is the project's. Read the traces before you let a run touch a real account.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you want to build a helper in Python and see the steps, not only the final reply. The 'ready to use' line is the project's. Read the step log before you let a run touch a real account.
